text_block_list.text:
Saying she was "on terrible terms with 
spring," 
Aston Machan had been falling ill 
frequently, 
and lately, she had been disappearing from 
sight more and more.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She was always the type to wander off on a 
whim, 
but still...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Something feels wrong. 
Almost as if she might just vanish into 
thin air—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Aaargh, forget it! Cut that out! 
Nothing good comes from wallowing in 
gloom!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Machan said she was looking forward to my 
yabusame, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Her poor health, whatever weird state 
she's in— 
I'm gonna banish all of it in one shot!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, alright. 
I'm hitting the mark consistently now.
choice_data_list:
At this rate, the real ritual is sure to 
be a success.

At this rate, the real ritual is sure to 
be a success.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm not letting it go to my head, though. 
I have to make sure this yabusame without 
a doubt 
drives away all of Machan's bad luck!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(...Right! There has to be 
even more I can do!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(For Machan's sake, 
every single thing I can do right now—)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you want your wish to come true, 
you don't have time to stand still. 
You go full power and do whatever it 
takes.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah. 
......She's right.)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please. 
I need your help.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Horsegirls today have received people's 
prayers across countless generations... 
so there has to be something only we can 
achieve today—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to pour every ounce of my strength 
into this! Everything I've got! 
I want to perform the absolute best 
yabusame I can!

Unlocking history can hold the key. 
Having learned that while preparing for 
the Goshiki Shuntaisai, 
we decided to search the ancient texts for 
clues.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The ancient bow used in this ritual 
is capable of firing three arrows in a 
single draw, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Still, that's strange. 
If that's the case, there should be 
records of horsegirls 
who performed yabusame with three arrows.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
There were those who attempted it. 
However, none could ever accomplish the 
feat.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Back then, the bond between humans and 
horsegirls had only just been forged. 
Even with the power of prayers, 
there were walls that could not be 
breached.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Not a single soul was strong enough. 
Deeming it impossible without a miracle, 
everyone sank to their knees in defeat.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And so, eventually no one stepped up to 
attempt it anymore, 
and the bows came to be made for shooting 
just a single arrow—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
The very concept of three-arrow yabusame 
was completely forgotten by people.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Back then, their strength fell short, and 
they couldn't reach it. 
...But things might be different now, 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Carrying everyone's hopes like this, I 
know we can make a miracle happen—no! 
I *want* to make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because there's someone I need to 
reach...!!
choice_data_list: ...If anyone can do it, it's you, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer...!
choice_data_list:
As a human and as your tsunade—I believe 
in you!

As a human and as your tsunade—I believe 
in you!

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Yabusame with three arrows at once, you 
say?
choice_data_list:
Yes. If it's her, I know she can pull it 
off!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
For everyone entrusting their wishes to 
me, 
for everyone who passed down this history 
and prepared this attire. 
And... for the girl who said she was 
looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to show them the greatest Goshiki 
Shuntaisai in history— 
one that only an Umamusume of today could 
ever achieve...!

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructors
choice_data_list:
I'll handle all the coordination and 
errands! Please!

I'll handle all the coordination and 
errands! Please!

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
............ 
Understood. Let us do it.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great to me! 
I've seen firsthand how hard you've been 
working this whole time. 
I have no doubt you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor C
text_block_list.text:
We all share the same desire to make this 
yabusame truly wonderful. 
Just as you are giving everything for 
others, 
we want to support you with everything we 
have...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Thank you so much, everyone!!
choice_data_list: I'll give you everything I've got, too!
I'll give you everything I've got, too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Right! 
From here on, we switch to practicing the 
three-arrow technique. 
I'll polish this yabusame until it's 
number one in time for the real thing!

title: Joining Hands Toward a Brighter Path
